readings: What are the top 10 branch districts (`account.district_id`) by share of all accounts? For each, show the district id, its number of accounts and its share of all accounts, without rounding, listed from the highest share down.
queries:
SELECT
    district_id,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account) AS account_share
FROM account
GROUP BY district_id
ORDER BY account_share DESC, district_id
LIMIT 10
